correlation.finding: The candidate was frozen on main while the repository's own candidate/security evidence was not green. The direct-push path is not blocked by branch protection, so CI can detect an unsafe state after it has already landed on main.

containment: do not interpret a freeze commit or manifest test summary as promotion approval
keep 0.6.76 staging-only, fixture-only, pilot-not-ready and production-not-approved
require exact-candidate runtime-integrity, every-push security and browser/customer proof before promotion
harden owner-push workflow trust without weakening deployment or autonomy gates

regression_rules.must_hold: a candidate freeze or promotion record is evidence-only unless all required exact-candidate gates are green
any required security, integrity, provenance or browser-proof failure on the candidate blocks pilot/production promotion
private staging workflows execute only from owner-originated pushes, pinned runner versions and immutable action SHAs
until branch protection is enforced, a successful push to main is never treated as proof that required checks passed before the change landed

steps: preserve the candidate and failing evidence
repair independent workflow-security defects on a bounded branch
repair deployment/provenance defects without weakening validators
promote only if main has not moved incompatibly and every required gate is green
